primary_sources_screened.work: Arvind and Raman, Approximation Algorithms for some Parameterized Counting Problems, ECCC TR02-031 (2002)
primary_sources_screened.interface_and_cost: Unweighted size-k graph matchings; k^{O(k)} n^{O(1)} time, approximation ratio 1/k^{O(k)}, error probability 2^{-n^{O(1)}}.

primary_sources_screened.work: Friedland and Levy, A polynomial-time approximation algorithm for the number of k-matchings in bipartite graphs (2006 preprint)
primary_sources_screened.interface_and_cost: Nonnegative m-by-n matrix B; partial permanent perm_k(B), equal to weighted bipartite k-matchings. Reduction to permanent of order m+n-k yields an FPRAS polynomial in the padded input size and accuracy; source abstract does not supply bit-model exponent.

primary_sources_screened.work: Liu, Chen, and Wang, On Counting 3-D Matchings of Size k, Algorithmica 54 (2009)
primary_sources_screened.interface_and_cost: N triples, k pairwise coordinate-disjoint triples; O(5.48^{3k} N^2 ln(2/delta)/epsilon^2) randomized relative approximation.

primary_sources_screened.work: Liu, Wang, and Wang, Parameterized counting matching and packing: A family of hard problems that admit FPTRAS, TCS 734 (2018)
primary_sources_screened.interface_and_cost: Graph matching, set packing, and vertex/edge-disjoint subgraph packing; abstract states #W[1]-hardness for a series and FPTRAS existence for each considered problem, without exposing individual f(k) factors.

primary_sources_screened.work: Jain, Perkins, Sah, and Sawhney, Approximate Counting and Sampling via Local Central Limit Theorems (2021 preprint)
primary_sources_screened.interface_and_cost: Unweighted m_k(G) for max-degree Delta graphs and k <= (1-delta)m*(G); deterministic relative FPTAS in (n/epsilon)^{O_{delta,Delta}(1)} time.

principal_comparison: These sources establish prior FPTRAS/FPTAS results for nonnegative discrete matching and packing counts. The assigned target instead sums squared complex determinants over disjoint site-indexed minor pairs. No direct approximation-preserving reduction between these interfaces was found in this bounded screen.
status: AUDIT_WRITTEN; no general residual-stability proof, external priority clearance, or complex-minor reduction claimed.
